evidence.reason: At 355-360 the receipt failure is only overlaid on the returned `result`; neither `queue`, the item, nor the request binding records it, and `reviewStatus` derives status solely from the queue. A replay/status projection of the same request therefore cannot reproduce `next_action: resubmit` / `receipt-unavailable` and can report completion, leaving a client that lost the first response without the recovery instruction. This is an ordinary idempotent/replay consistency bug in the existing admission behavior, not a request for new scope. Persist the condition or apply the receipt check when projecting retry/status responses.
